items.headline: US stocks: S&P 500, Nasdaq reach record closing highs as focus pivots to earnings
items.summary: The US stock market finished on a high note, buoyed by stabilizing crude prices and easing Treasury yields, offering much-needed relief to investors. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq celebrated record closing highs, indicative of a widespread market upturn.

items.headline: S&P 500, Nasdaq reach record closing highs as focus pivots to earnings
items.summary: NEW YORK, Oct 6 (Reuters) - US stocks ended higher on Tuesday as crude prices steadied and US Treasury yields eased, offering some reprieve from concerns that have preoccupied investors in recent weeks, and allowing markets to turn their attention to the approaching third-quarter reporting season...
